name: Qian Wenxiang
biography: Qian Wenxiang is a security researcher at the Tencent Blade Team of Tencent Security Platform Department. His is focusing on security research of IoT devices. He also performed security audits for web browsers. He was on the top 100 of annual MSRC list (2016 & 2017 ). He published a book called "Whitehat Talk About Web Browser Security ".
